verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of Jira's performance at scale or of any item, issue or project caps for workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks. Community comments offer only general, conflicting impressions of speed ("quick and responsive" versus "heavy and slow"), with no reference to dataset size or limits. That is not enough to credit the capability, and with no vendor claim to contradict, there is nothing to dispute.

support.subject: As an engineer, I know how the product performs and whether item caps apply in workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks
